name: @depths/tach
description: Managed TypeScript runtime and native compiler for Tach GPU kernels

scripts.build: deno run -A scripts/build.ts && deno run -A scripts/instructions.ts
scripts.check: deno lint src declarations scripts cli.ts tests && deno check src/index.ts src/internal.ts src/compiler.ts declarations/*.ts cli.ts scripts/*.ts tests/*.js && deno run --allow-read scripts/instructions.ts --check
scripts.test: npm run build && deno test -A --node-modules-dir=manual tests
